text.line.m.a1.03.gate: Sunday night, the lot behind the cranes. Bring a car that likes to slide.
text.line.m.a1.03.follow: Stay close. The crowd is already there.
text.line.m.a1.03.home: Everybody scattered. Get back to the Yard before the next patrol comes through.
text.line.m.a1.03.raid.1: Lights! Patrol on the fence line, everybody out the back!
text.line.m.a1.03.raid.2: Go, go. Do not stop for anything!
text.line.m.a1.03.raid: Patrol is on the lot. Lose them and head for the Yard.
text.line.m.a1.03.show: Give them a show. Three thousand points of smoke and the lot is yours.
text.mission.m.a1.03.fail.ko: You went down. Get up and try again.
text.mission.m.a1.03.fail.ride: The car is wrecked. Start again.
text.mission.m.a1.03.obj.goto_gate: Meet Tavi at the Yard gate
text.mission.m.a1.03.title: Sideshow Sunday
